name: Tripwire
description: Deterministic host guard, per-run tool budgets and exec approvals for OpenClaw agents.

cliCommands.name: tripwire
cliCommands.description: Check Tripwire setup, test commands against the guard, manage approvals

dataDir.description: Where grants and the decision log are kept. Default <OpenClaw state>/state/tripwire.

hostGuard.description: Deterministic rules that run before every tool call.

enabled.description: Turn the host guard on. Default true.

agents.description: Agent ids to guard. Empty (default) guards every agent.

secretPaths.description: Extra secret files or folders (~ allowed). Added to the built-in list (~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.openclaw/credentials, keychains, …).

protectedPaths.description: Extra files or folders the agent may read but never write, move or delete.

keepFolders.description: Extra folders that recursive rm may never remove.

protectOpenClawConfig.description: Block direct writes to ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json and openclaw config set on plugin/exec/hook/approval settings. Default true.

protectPluginFiles.description: Block agent writes anywhere in this plugin folder, not only its policy files. Default true.

blockInsecureTls.description: Block commands that switch off TLS certificate checks (curl -k, NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0, …). Default true.

toolBudget.description: Per-run limits that stop an agent that is looping.

enabled.description: Turn the budget on. Default true.

agents.description: Agent ids to limit. Empty (default) limits every agent.

maxSeconds.description: Seconds spent inside tools per run (model thinking time does not count). Default 900.

maxFailures.description: Failed tool calls per run. Default 8.

refuseRepeats.description: Refuse an exact repeat of a call that already ran in the run. Re-reads after a successful edit are allowed. Default true.

execTimeoutCapSeconds.description: If above 0, every exec runs in the foreground with at most this timeout. Default 0 (off).

statefulTools.description: Tools whose identical calls are new evidence (counted, never refused as repeats). browser, computer and process are always included.

untimedTools.description: Slow tools with their own timeouts; their time does not count toward maxSeconds.

recoveryTools.description: Sign-in or recovery tools. A successful call forgives one failure and lets a failed call run once more.

execApproval.description: Review host shell commands and ask the owner through OpenClaw plugin approvals.

enabled.description: Turn exec approval on. Default false.

mode.description: review: a model allows routine commands and asks you about the rest. ask: every command that is not read-only or granted asks you.

agents.description: Agent ids to review. Empty (default) reviews every agent.

model.description: Review model (provider/model). Default: the host default model. Setting it needs llm.allowModelOverride.

language.description: Language of approval prompts and review reasons.

askTimeoutSeconds.description: How long an approval waits before the command is blocked. Default 240.

reviewTimeoutSeconds.description: Time limit for one model review; on timeout the owner is asked. Default 20.

maxAsksPerRun.description: Approvals one run may request before further commands are blocked. Default 3.

readOnlyCommands.description: Extra command names that are read-only and never need review (e.g. your own status CLIs).
